"Agentic AI has arrived." NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang declared during his recent GTC 2026 keynote in Taipei. A new consensus is forming: both individuals and enterprises will have their own agents, and social productivity will be reshaped.  

In the face of this wave, how can agents be deployed securely, run efficiently, and continuously create value? As an NVIDIA partner, Aoni has delivered concrete answers for real-world implementation.  

On June 9, Aoni unveiled a series of major achievements, spanning hardware infrastructure, operating systems, computing networks, and open ecosystems, offering a new practical path for large-scale agent deployment.  

End-side Agent Operating System: Aoni AI Agent OS 1.0 Global Launch  

In the PC era, Windows defined the entry point for personal computing; in the mobile era, iOS reshaped human-computer interaction. Now, the agent era also requires a dedicated operating system.  

Aoni AI Agent OS 1.0 was born for this purpose. Built on NVIDIA Jetson Thor, it is a localized end-side agent operating system designed for government, enterprise, industry-specific private deployments, and offline confidential scenarios. It provides full-stack AI capabilities, including model execution, inference scheduling, agent management, security control, and operational auditing.
